name: product-one-pager
description: The product-one-pager methodology: JTBD problem-without-solution framing for the current-state survey — the problem stated as a job-performer/job/circumstance/desired-outcome 4-tuple, fixed before any solution name appears; if the issue text embeds a solution, the survey restates the problem in the customer's terms and notes the gap. Ships skills: one-pager.
